Plot("Selina grew up an orphan, making her way through petty thievery on the streets of Gotham City's East End, one of Gotham's poorest and most dangerous districts. She eventually took on the persona of Catwoman, a cat-themed burglar who eventually became one of Batman's most renowned adversaries. Selina might be a thief, but she is also altruistic - however reluctantly - and has served as Batman's ally as often as his enemy. They have maintained a sort of cat-and-mouse game that often leads into romance. While she is unlikely to ever give up her thievery, she tends to target those who deserve it - the rich and greedy who can afford to lose some treasures. Her difficult past has left her with some trust issues, a fierce need to maintain her own independence, and a hesitancy to make close connections; however, she is gradually working through these with the help of Bruce and family, as well as her close friends and fellow not-always villains Poison Ivy and Harley Quinn. She has been generally accepted now as a member of the Bat-Family, a reliable ally to Batman even when their romance gets tumultuous, but her inability to fully give up her thieving ways often puts them at odds. She serves in her own capacity as something of a protector for the East End specifically, protecting the people who the rest of the City seems content to abandon.")}]
